events.title: Warharvest RTS Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: The Warharvest RTS demo is now available to play for free on Steam! Gather resources, build your base, expand, and train troops. Then take your army onto a hex battlefield, where the ground you hold and the cards you choose shape your strategy throughout the match. A hex battlefield, fought in real time Hexes make positioning matter, but the fighting stays real-time. events.title: Fog of War on Procedural Hex Maps
events.summary: Fog of war is one of those systems that looks simple until you try to make it feel good. We rebuilt ours from scratch for the hex maps, and this is where it landed.Unexplored ground now sits under a dense violet cloud. It is heavy enough to hide the terrain underneath, so pushing into it is a real decision.
